rule.response:
### Possible causes
A fever means your body temperature is higher than normal, usually 38 C (100.4 F) or above. It is often a sign that the body is fighting an infection.

_These are only possibilities - many different things can cause these symptoms, and I cannot tell which applies to you._

### When to seek medical help
See a doctor if the fever lasts more than 3 days, goes above 39.5 C (103 F), or comes with a stiff neck, rash, confusion, trouble breathing or severe pain.

_This is general health information, not a diagnosis. A qualified clinician can assess your own situation._

- Call 112 (India emergency number) or go to the nearest hospital now.
- You can also call Tele-MANAS, the Government of India free 24x7 mental health helpline, on 14416 or 1800-891-4416.
- If you can, tell someone you trust and stay with them.

- Urgent assessment by a Psychiatrist or at the nearest hospital emergency department is advised.
